segments.an7.74:1.1: “Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, arako nāma satthā ahosi titthakaro kāmesu vītarāgo.
segments.an7.74:1.2: Arakassa kho pana, bhikkhave, satthuno anekāni sāvakasatāni ahesuṃ.
segments.an7.74:1.3: Arako satthā sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ deseti –
segments.an7.74:1.4: appakaṃ, brāhmaṇa, jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ [lahusaṃ (ṭīkā)] bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ mantāyaṃ [mantāya (sabbattha) ṭīkā passitabbā] boddhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
segments.an7.74:2.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, tiṇagge ussāvabindu sūriye uggacchante khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti;
segments.an7.74:2.2: evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, ussāvabindūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ mantāyaṃ boddhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
segments.an7.74:3.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, thullaphusitake deve vassante udakabubbuḷaṃ [udakapupphuḷaṃ (ka.)] khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikaṃ hoti;
segments.an7.74:3.2: evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, udakabubbuḷūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ mantāyaṃ boddhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
segments.an7.74:4.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, udake daṇḍarāji khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
segments.an7.74:4.2: evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, udake daṇḍarājūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ … pe …
segments.an7.74:5.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, nadī pabbateyyā dūraṅgamā sīghasotā hārahārinī, natthi so khaṇo vā layo vā muhutto vā yaṃ sā [yāya (ka.)] āvattati [tharati (sī.), dharati (syā.), avatiṭṭheyya (?)], atha kho sā gacchateva vattateva sandateva;
segments.an7.74:5.2: evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, nadīpabbateyyūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ … pe …
segments.an7.74:6.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, balavā puriso jivhagge kheḷapiṇḍaṃ saṃyūhitvā akasireneva vameyya [patāpeyya (ka.)];
segments.an7.74:6.2: evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, kheḷapiṇḍūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ … pe …
segments.an7.74:7.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, divasaṃsantatte ayokaṭāhe maṃsapesi [maṃsapesī (sī. syā.)] pakkhittā khippaṃyeva paṭivigacchati, na ciraṭṭhitikā hoti;
segments.an7.74:7.2: evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, maṃsapesūpamaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ … pe …
segments.an7.74:8.1: “Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, gāvī vajjhā āghātanaṃ nīyamānā yaṃ yadeva pādaṃ uddharati, santikeva hoti vadhassa santikeva maraṇassa;
segments.an7.74:8.2: evamevaṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, govajjhūpamaṃ [gāvīvajjhūpamaṃ (sī. syā.)] jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ mantāyaṃ boddhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇan”ti.
segments.an7.74:9.1: “Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ saṭṭhivassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi, pañcavassasatikā kumārikā alaṃpateyyā ahosi.
segments.an7.74:9.2: Tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ chaḷeva ābādhā ahesuṃ –
segments.an7.74:9.3: sītaṃ, uṇhaṃ, jighacchā, pipāsā, uccāro, passāvo.
segments.an7.74:9.4: So hi nāma, bhikkhave, arako satthā evaṃ dīghāyukesu manussesu evaṃ ciraṭṭhitikesu evaṃ appābādhesu sāvakānaṃ evaṃ dhammaṃ desessati –
segments.an7.74:9.5: ‘appakaṃ, brāhmaṇa, jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ mantāyaṃ boddhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇan’”ti.
segments.an7.74:10.2: ‘appakaṃ jīvitaṃ manussānaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ bahudukkhaṃ bahupāyāsaṃ mantāyaṃ boddhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, natthi jātassa amaraṇan’ti.
segments.an7.74:10.3: Etarahi, bhikkhave, yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
segments.an7.74:10.4: Vassasataṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, jīvanto tīṇiyeva utusatāni jīvati –
segments.an7.74:10.5: utusataṃ hemantānaṃ, utusataṃ gimhānaṃ, utusataṃ vassānaṃ.
segments.an7.74:10.6: Tīṇi kho pana, bhikkhave, utusatāni jīvanto dvādasa [dvādasaṃ (sī. ka.)] yeva māsasatāni jīvati –
segments.an7.74:10.7: cattāri māsasatāni hemantānaṃ, cattāri māsasatāni gimhānaṃ, cattāri māsasatāni vassānaṃ.
segments.an7.74:10.8: Dvādasa kho pana, bhikkhave, māsasatāni jīvanto catuvīsatiyeva addhamāsasatāni jīvati –
segments.an7.74:10.9: aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni hemantānaṃ, aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni gimhānaṃ, aṭṭhaddhamāsasatāni vassānaṃ.
segments.an7.74:10.10: Catuvīsati kho pana, bhikkhave, addhamāsasatāni jīvanto chattiṃsaṃyeva rattisahassāni jīvati –
segments.an7.74:10.11: dvādasa rattisahassāni hemantānaṃ, dvādasa rattisahassāni gimhānaṃ, dvādasa rattisahassāni vassānaṃ.
segments.an7.74:10.12: Chattiṃsaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, rattisahassāni jīvanto dvesattatiyeva [dvesattatiññeva (syā.), dvesattatiñceva (ka.)] bhattasahassāni bhuñjati –
segments.an7.74:10.13: catuvīsati bhattasahassāni hemantānaṃ, catuvīsati bhattasahassāni gimhānaṃ, catuvīsati bhattasahassāni vassānaṃ saddhiṃ mātuthaññāya saddhiṃ bhattantarāyena.
segments.an7.74:11.1: “Tatrime bhattantarāyā kapimiddhopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, dukkhitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, byādhitopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, uposathikopi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati, alābhakenapi bhattaṃ na bhuñjati.
segments.an7.74:11.2: Iti kho, bhikkhave, mayā vassasatāyukassa manussassa āyupi saṅkhāto [saṅkhātaṃ (?)], āyuppamāṇampi saṅkhātaṃ, utūpi saṅkhātā, saṃvaccharāpi saṅkhātā, māsāpi saṅkhātā, addhamāsāpi saṅkhātā, rattipi saṅkhātā, divāpi saṅkhātā, bhattāpi saṅkhātā, bhattantarāyāpi saṅkhātā.
segments.an7.74:11.3: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya;
segments.an7.74:11.4: kataṃ vo taṃ mayā etāni, bhikkhave, rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha, bhikkhave, mā pamādattha; mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī”ti.

lines: Mantāyaṃ boddhabbanti mantāya boddhabbaṃ, paññāya jānitabbanti attho.
Pabandhānupacchedassa paccayabhāvo idha jīvitassa raso kiccanti adhippetanti āha “sarasaparittatāyapī”ti.
Tadadhīnavuttitāyapi hi “yo, bhikkhave, ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo”ti vacanato parittaṃ khaṇaparittatāyapi.
Paramatthato hi atiparitto sattānaṃ jīvitakkhaṇo ekacittakkhaṇappavattimattoyeva.
Yathā nāma rathacakkaṃ pavattamānampi ekeneva nemippadesena pavattati, tiṭṭhamānampi ekeneva tiṭṭhati, evamevaṃ ekacittakkhaṇikaṃ sattānaṃ jīvitaṃ tasmiṃ citte niruddhamatte satto niruddhoti vuccati.
Yathāha “atīte cittakkhaṇe jīvittha na jīvati na jīvissati.
Anāgate cittakkhaṇe na jīvittha na jīvati jīvissati.
Paccuppanne cittakkhaṇe na jīvittha jīvati na jīvissati.
Yañhi appakaṃ, taṃ parittañceva lahukañca hoti.
Idha pana āyuno adhippetattā rassanti vuttaṃ hoti.
Mantāyanti karaṇatthe etaṃ bhummavacananti āha “mantāya boddhabbaṃ, paññāya jānitabbanti attho”ti.
Mantāyanti vā manteyyanti vuttaṃ hoti, mantetabbaṃ mantāya upaparikkhitabbanti attho.
Jānitvā ca pana sabbapalibodhe chinditvā kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ.
Yasmā itthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ, appaṃ vā bhiyyo vassasatato upari appaṃ aññaṃ vassasataṃ appatvā vīsaṃ vā tiṃsaṃ vā cattālīsaṃ vā paṇṇāsaṃ vā saṭṭhi vā vassāni jīvati, evaṃdīghāyuko pana atidullabho.
“Asuko hi evaṃ ciraṃ jīvatī”ti tattha tattha gantvā daṭṭhabbo hoti.
Tattha visākhā upāsikā vīsasataṃ jīvati, tathā pokkharasātibrāhmaṇo, brahmāyubrāhmaṇo, bāvariyabrāhmaṇo, ānandatthero, mahākassapattheroti.
Bākulatthero vassasatañceva saṭṭhi ca vassāni, ayaṃ sabbadīghāyuko, sopi dve vassasatāni na jīvi.
